reviewer_role: bounded execution worker; not an author of ledger/citation_audit.csv, not a G-LIT owner, no canonical write
review_kind: full independent (non-author, non-owner) read-only audit of the decidable G-LIT acceptance axes at the frozen pins, with an independently written stdlib-only checker, a 13-control battery, and a published post-hoc amendment for one strict-predicate false positive
score_basis: No blocking defect fires on any decidable axis; accept is bounded to the decidable axes and to bytes 315c19145065 (and companion pins). It is NOT a decision of: rubric HF-02 scope for multi-class ledger rows, or REC-6 exact_locator vs evidence_url; those two are REFERRED to the standing controller+A0 ruling (BL-7-consolidated).

findings.text: Shape and core binding checks are clean at the pin: 97 data rows, 97 unique citation_ids and bibkeys, no missing frozen column; B1 foreign class token 0/97; B2 no record anchor 0/97; B3 resolution/verdict mismatch 0/97 (all resolver_result=resolved, all statuses verified-*); B6 status overstatement 0/97; all class_mapping tokens that exist are inside the frozen four.
findings.falsifier: Any row at 315c1914 firing one of B1/B2/B3/B6 on an independent re-run.

findings.text: Cross-surface binding is clean: all 97 used_by_theorems/assessment theorem ids resolve in ledger/theorems.jsonl at a1674f09 (B4 0/97); assessment ids equal used_by_theorems ids for 97/97 (B9 0/97); every row that carries class tokens intersects the class_ids of at least one referenced theorem (B5 0/97); all 97 source ids exist in artifacts/literature/registry.jsonl ea02d194 with 0 title mismatches.
findings.falsifier: A dangling theorem id, an assessment/used_by divergence, a row whose tokens are disjoint from its theorems' class_ids, or a source id absent/title-mismatched in the registry, at the pinned hashes.

findings.text: Duplicate-cluster annotation is complete under the amended predicate: 11 multi-row identity components; each has exactly one empty mirror_of primary and every mirror_of resolves inside its component; duplicate_cluster_rate 11/97 = 0.1134, inside the G-AUDIT <=0.25 criterion. The 5 MANIFEST-listed unassessed sources (SRC-090/092/093/096/097) are present as rows, not dropped; unresolved.jsonl carries 12 theorem-level entries (no silent drop at L0).
findings.falsifier: A component with zero or >=2 primaries, a mirror_of outside its component, or an unassessed/unresolved item absent from both the ledger and the disclosure files.

findings.text: HF-02 scope: 41/97 rows carry the local annotation '(evidence/tag only)' instead of a class token and 26/97 carry >1 class token (24 two-class + 2 three-class: SRC-040, SRC-078); 0/97 carry a foreign class token. Whether the rubric-literal HF-02 'disjunction of class_ids' (critical) applies to ledger rows at all is the standing BL-7-consolidated question to controller+A0; this review reports the counts and does not decide it.
findings.falsifier: The controller/A0 ruling recorded at the rubric hash; or a recount at the pin differing from 41/26/0.

findings.text: Locator-column scope: under this reviewer's own record-locator predicate the exact_locator column is 18/97 record-shaped and 79/97 non-record (40 discovery-query, 27 literal '...' truncated, 12 other HTTP; the lead's predicate counts 30/97 record-shaped; the boundary differs on metadata endpoints). artifacts/literature/L0_L1_ACCEPTANCE.md line 'The L1 `exact_locator` column carries the primary page/record URL' is therefore falsified as a universal claim, but 0/97 rows lack a record anchor in doi/arxiv_id/url/evidence_url, so the evidence-binding criterion is met or not depending on the REC-6 reading; REFERRED, not re-adjudicated.
findings.falsifier: The controller/A0 ruling on REC-6; or a row with no record anchor at the pin.

findings.text: Self-certification: the reviewer column is lead-literature for 92/97 rows and astra-lead-literature for 5/97; no row records an independent reviewer. Independent evidence for L1 exists only in the separate review trail, not in the ledger's own reviewer field.
findings.falsifier: Rows whose reviewer field names a non-author reviewer, or a ledger revision that records independent review inline.

findings.text: Status/method naming asymmetry (under-claiming, not over-claiming): SRC-043 is verified-api with verification_method 'primary-page-fetch'; SRC-070/096/097 are verified-primary with an '*-api' method. No row claims verified-primary on metadata-only evidence.
findings.falsifier: A status/method pair that claims more evidence than the recorded method/evidence_type supports.

findings.text: The pre-registered strict B7 predicate fired once (component {SRC-060,SRC-072}; 3 defect entries) because SRC-020 is the DOI-less INSPIRE primary and the mirror titles carry provenance suffixes ('(Crossref record)', '(OpenAlex abstract reconstruction)'). Manual identity check (same author/year/venue/paper, both mirrors declare mirror_of=SRC-020) shows the annotation is semantically correct; the firing is a lexical false positive of the reviewer's own predicate. Published amendment A1 (post-hoc, disclosed) strips one trailing parenthetical for the duplicate key and adds mirror_of edges; strict result 3 is preserved verbatim in report.json; amended result 0; blast radius is exactly {SRC-020,SRC-060,SRC-072} (control K9).
findings.falsifier: Any component other than SRC-020/060/072 changing defect status under the amended predicate, or the three rows failing the identity check (same author/year/venue/DOI).

findings.text: Weak predicates tested and REJECTED as non-defects during calibration, because they fire on legitimate record pairs: DOI string absent from the URL set (80/97), arXiv id absent from the URL set (5/97), arXiv-year skew when a preprint is published later (3/97), and first-author-surname-in-bibkey matching (30/97 false positives). None is used as a blocking check.
findings.falsifier: A citation that is genuinely unsupported yet passes B1..B9 because these weak predicates were rejected.
